hero.h1: Tailored pricing for your garden's unique needs
hero.lead: Every price includes full waste removal, nothing extra to collect, nothing left behind.

priceFactors.heading: Garden size
priceFactors.body: Small, medium or larger gardens are priced differently because clearance time scales with area, not just mess.

priceFactors.heading: Number of pets
priceFactors.body: More pets means more waste per visit, reflected in the per-pet step-up.

priceFactors.heading: Access and terrain
priceFactors.body: Decking, stones, slate, artificial grass and overgrown areas take longer to clear properly, so these are quoted with that in mind.

priceFactors.heading: Frequency
priceFactors.body: Weekly stays tidier and costs less per visit than fortnightly, where build-up is greater each time.

priceFactors.heading: Build-up
priceFactors.body: First cleans on a neglected garden are priced separately, usually from £20 depending on what's there.

faq.q: How much does pet waste removal cost?
faq.a: From £10 per clean for a small garden with one pet on a weekly round, rising with garden size, number of pets and frequency. See our pricing page for the full breakdown.

faq.q: Why are first cleans priced separately?
faq.a: If there's a build-up, long grass, decking, stones, slate or artificial grass, the first visit takes considerably longer. First cleans usually start from £20 depending on what's there.

seo.title: Pet Waste Garden Clean-Ups in Aberdare & RCT, Scoop Patrol Aberdare
seo.description: Weekly, fortnightly and one-off pet waste garden clean-ups across Rhondda Cynon Taf. Pet-safe sanitising, waste always taken away. NRW registered.

hero.lead: We clear every visible piece of pet waste from your garden, treat the area with pet-safe sanitiser, and take everything away with us.

whatIncluded.lead: Every visit covers the whole garden, not just the lawn. Patios, paths, decking and artificial grass are all cleared and treated as part of the same clean, at no extra charge.
items: Full clearance of visible pet waste across every surface
Treatment with our pet-safe deodorising and sanitising spray
All waste bagged and taken away, nothing left in your bin
Legal disposal under our NRW waste carrier registration

frequencyCards.heading: Weekly
frequencyCards.body: The most popular choice. Keeps a garden consistently tidy and low-odour, and each visit is quicker because there's less to clear, which is why it costs less per visit.

frequencyCards.heading: Fortnightly
frequencyCards.body: Suits smaller, single-pet gardens where build-up is slower. Each visit takes a little longer, so the per-visit price is higher than weekly.

frequencyCards.heading: One-off
frequencyCards.body: A single clean whenever you need one, before visitors, before a house move, or just to reset a garden that's got away from you. No commitment to anything after it.

gardenCleans.firstCleansNote: 🧾 First cleans. If there's already a build-up, long grass, decking, stones, slate or artificial grass, the first visit takes considerably longer, so it's priced separately, usually from £20 depending on what's there. After that you're onto your normal rate.

surfaces.lead1: We don't just do lawns. Patios, paths, decking and artificial grass all get cleared and treated as part of your clean.
surfaces.lead2: Artificial grass is the one people ask about most. Urine soaks past the surface into the backing, which is why hosing it down doesn't shift the smell. Every visit, we clear the waste and treat the area with our pet-safe deodorising and sanitising spray, so odour is kept on top of rather than allowed to build up.
surfaces.calloutHeading: Being straight about what this is
surfaces.calloutP1: This is part of a regular clean, not a separate deep-clean or restoration service. Regular visits prevent build-up; they won't undo years of saturation.
surfaces.calloutP2: If artificial grass has been left a long time and the smell has reached the infill or sub-base underneath, regular sanitising will help but may not fully fix it. That usually needs specialist restoration or infill replacement, which isn't something we offer. We'll tell you straight if that's what we find.

winter.lead: Waste doesn't stop in bad weather, and neither do we. We work all year round, rain or shine. If severe weather ever makes a visit genuinely unsafe or pointless, we'll message you and either move it to the next available slot or skip it at no charge.

seo.title: Pet Waste & Cat Litter Collection, Aberdare & RCT | Scoop Patrol
seo.description: Already bag your own pet waste or cat litter? We collect and dispose of it legally. Collections from £10 across Rhondda Cynon Taf. NRW registered waste carrier.

hero.h1: Pet waste collection, you bag it, we take it away
hero.lead: Some customers already collect and bag their own pet waste but don't want the job of storing it or getting it to the bin. That's exactly what this is for.

pricingRows.service: Larger bags, bins or multiple bags

regularOrOneOff.heading: Regular or one-off
regularOrOneOff.body: Collections work either way. Most customers settle into a weekly or fortnightly rhythm that lines up with their own routine, but a single one-off collection is absolutely fine: say after a clear-out, or when storage has got on top of you.

whoItsFor.heading: Who it's for
whoItsFor.body: Customers who already have their own routine and don't need a garden clean, or who simply have nowhere to store bagged waste between council collections. If you'd rather we did the clearing too, that's our garden clean service.

legal.heading: Why it matters that we're registered
legal.body: When you hand waste over to someone else, where it ends up stops being something you can see. That's exactly why carrier registration exists, and why it is worth checking, whoever you use. Most local operators aren't registered. We are, and the number above is yours to verify.

catLitter.intro: Got a cat as well as a dog? We'll take your bagged litter away at the same time as your garden clean, one visit, one less job.
catLitter.howItWorks: Bag your used litter as you normally would and leave it out ready for your scheduled visit. We'll collect it alongside your garden clean and take it away with us. There's no separate call-out to arrange and nothing extra for you to do on the day, if you're already on the round, it simply gets added to the visit you've already got booked.
catLitter.cost: £3 per bag, collected during an existing visit. As a worked example, a standard weekly clean at £15 plus four bags of litter at £3 each comes to £27 for the week.
catLitter.calloutBody: One thing to be clear about: this is an add-on to a scheduled visit, not a standalone service. We don't currently offer cat-litter-only collection without a garden clean or waste collection booked alongside it. If that's what you're after, message us anyway, if there's enough demand it's something we'd look at.

cta.heading: Ready to hand it over?
cta.body: Message us with your area and roughly how much you need collected, we'll quote it fairly, usually the same day.
